---
name: Bug report
about: Something Transmute did not do what you expected
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
---

<!-- Short is fine. Rough is fine. Just enough that we can re-test it on our own machines. -->

**1. What were you doing?**
<!-- What you converted (from what type to what type), the kind of file and roughly how big, and the steps 1-2-3.
Example: "Picked a 45 MB .MOV in Movies, chose MP4, clicked Convert." -->

**2. What did you expect, and what happened instead?**
<!-- Copy the exact error text or add a screenshot. If the app froze, crashed, or produced a broken file, say which. -->

**3. Does it happen every time?**
<!-- Every time / only with this file / only sometimes. If the same steps work on a different file, tell us that too - it narrows it down fast. -->

**4. Your machine**
- Operating system: <!-- e.g. Windows 11, Windows 10, Ubuntu 24.04, Fedora 42 -->
- Transmute version: <!-- shown in the title bar / About, or the exact file name you downloaded -->
- How you installed it: <!-- pip / pipx / AppImage / nix / source / other -->

**5. What Transmute says about your helper programs**
<!-- Transmute uses programs you already have (ffmpeg, LibreOffice, Ghostscript, ...).
On the main screen it lists which ones it found. Which show a check and which show a warning?
A screenshot of that list is the fastest answer. If Transmute will not start at all, skip this - that IS the bug. -->

**6. Anything else that might matter**
<!-- Special file names (accents, spaces, very long paths), network or external drives, files on a
different disk than your program, recently updated anything, antivirus that asks about the app... write anything. -->
